verdict.rationale: Notte documents an integration guide for running OpenAI's Computer Use Agent (CUA) on its browser infrastructure, so screenshot-driven computer-use control is possible. It works by pairing Notte with an external model rather than through a native vision or computer-use mode in Notte's own agent or action API, whose docs instead stress element IDs and selectors from `observe()`. Missing for 10: a native, switchable vision/screenshot action mode in Notte's agent, documentation of how it handles canvases or DOM-opaque UIs, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
